title: View all rooms of a hostel without drilling into floors
description: Currently seeing a hostel's rooms requires Property -> hostel -> floor -> room list, one floor at a time. Wardens want a single flat view of every room in a hostel across all floors, for a quick full-property scan.
acceptanceCriteria: A hostel-level 'All Rooms' view lists every room across every floor, with the floor labeled per row
Reachable directly from the hostel screen, not just via each floor
Tapping a room still opens its normal bed grid / edit flow

history.note: Added from the v2 feedback session (warden interviews after the v1 field test) and from buried enhancement/limitation notes surfaced while re-reading the full v1 board history.
Starting - a hostel-level All Rooms screen listing every room across every floor with its floor labelled, reachable from the hostel row, reusing the existing room -> bed grid navigation.

Added a hostel-level All Rooms screen (ui/property/AllRoomsScreen.kt + AllRoomsViewModel.kt, route all_rooms/{hostelId}). RoomDao.getByHostelIdWithFloor returns rooms joined to their floor already ordered by floor sortOrder then room number, so each row carries its floor label without a per-room lookup, and BedDao.observeRoomOccupancyByHostel supplies the same vacant/total line the floor-scoped room list shows. Reachable from the hostel's own screen - an 'All rooms' action in FloorListScreen's app bar, so no floor has to be opened first. Tapping a room goes to its normal bed grid, the same destination the per-floor list uses. AllRoomsViewModelTest covers the cross-floor listing and bed counts, including a room with no beds yet. testDebugUnitTest green.

PASS. AC1: 'All rooms' lists every room across every floor with the floor label on each row (Ground / Room 101 / 2 vacant / 2 beds / DOUBLE). AC2: reachable directly from the hostel screen via the 'All rooms' top-bar action, no floor drill-down needed. AC3: tapping Room 102 from this view opened its normal bed grid with the usual All/Vacant/Occupied filters, identical to arriving via the floor route.
